sanskrit_verse:
वादिभ्यामभ्यनुज्ञातं शेषं च फलके स्थितम्‌ ।
ससाक्षिकं लिखेयुस्ते प्रतिपत्तिं च वादिनोः ॥
transliteration: vādibhyām abhyanujñātaṃ śeṣaṃ ca phalake sthitam | sasākṣikaṃ likheyus te pratipattiṃ ca vādinoḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is mutually acknowledged by both disputants and what remains inscribed upon the board—such evidence shall be recorded in the presence of witnesses, along with the understanding of the claimants.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in mutual recognition between parties
Restoration logic depends on visible, witnessed truth
Consciousness alignment occurs through shared acceptance
executable_legal_axioms: IF both parties acknowledge a fact THEN record it as admissible evidence
IF evidence is inscribed on a public ledger OR board THEN it qualifies for transcription
IF transcription occurs IN PRESENCE of neutral witnesses THEN it becomes binding record
IF claimant demonstrates conscious understanding OF their assertion THEN register intent formally
ALL records MUST maintain sequential visibility to ensure dharma-aligned continuity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that only mutually accepted facts and clearly inscribed data constitute actionable evidence. The court must reject unverified claims unless supported by consensual documentation witnessed under lawful observation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is based on reciprocal cognition (pratipatti), not coercion. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures each step—from acknowledgment to inscription to witnessing—is sequentially manifest without force. Responsibility flows from capacity to recognize and affirm, not from punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all disputed elements are either mutually agreed upon or definitively inscribed before proceeding
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require both parties to witness and confirm factual entries
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate joint review sessions until mutual acknowledgment is achieved
Capacity Restoration: Provide tools for clear articulation and visualization of claims prior to formal recording
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails where consciousness converges in clarity, consent, and visible truth. There is no punishment; there is only alignment.
